answer: Problem: rented keys spam governance votes. Mechanism: each voter posts a 1.2 POA stake into a walnut-keyed cooling vault for 36h; ballots only count after the voter publishes two independent work digests that hash under a public atlas of prior epoch tips, then a panel seals a ledge ticket with those digests. Cost: 1.2 POA locked plus ~20 min of real work. Verification: node drops any vote whose digests collide with another addr or whose ledge ticket lacks dual digests. Failure: if digests are missing by hour 36, slash 40% of the stake and freeze voting for three epochs.
